source_text: 华山位于华阴市，距西安120 公里。华山是秦岭的一部分，秦岭不仅分割陕南与陕北，也分隔华南与华北。与 从前人们常去朝拜的泰山不同，华山过去很少有人光临，因为上山的道路极其危险。然而，希望长寿的人却经常上 山，因为山上生长着许多草药，特别是一些稀有的药草。自上世纪90 年代安装缆车以来，参观人数大大增加。
reference_translation: Huashan Mountain is located in Huayin City, 120 kilometers away from Xi'an. It is part of the Qinling Mountains, which not only divide southern and northern Shaanxi but also separate South and North China. Unlike Mount Tai, which people used to visit frequently for religious worship, Huashan Mountain was rarely visited in the past because the roads up the mountain were extremely dangerous. However, people who hoped to live a long life often went up the mountain because there were many herbs growing on it, especially some rare ones. Since the cable cars were installed in the 1990s, the number of visitors has increased significantly.
